To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

an extract of Radex Stephaniae Tetandreae (RST), which is a Chinese herb that has been used for the treatment of cardiovascular disease for thousands of years, acts like a calcium channel blocker, and that the effects of the herb are of the same potency and duration as those of tetrandine, the major active component of the herb.
an extract of Radex Stephaniae Tetandrae, which is a traditional Chinese herb, is a calcium channel antagonist and has antihypertensive, anti‐arrhythmatic and anti‐infarct actions.
the RST extracts have anti‐arrhythmatic effects in rats with myocardial infarction, and may be useful in the treatment of myocardial infarct.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new antihypertensive, anti‐arrhythmatic and cardioprotective agents.
the effects of RST extract on cardiovascular diseases.
the development of a Chinese herbal medicine for the treatment of hypertension and myocardial ischaemic disease.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
RST extract is a calcium antagonist.
the RST is a calcium‐channel‐antagonist‐like drug and that its therapeutic effects are not only due to the calcium channel‐antagonist action of tetrandrine.
the RST extracts are effective in the treatment of high blood pressure, arrhythmia and cardiac infarction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RST has antihypertensive effects in the DOCA salt‐induced hypertensive rats and antiarrhythmic effects in the anaesthetised rat.
the RST is a promising candidate for the treatment of cardiovascular disease.
the RST is an important herb that has been used for centuries in the treatment of hypertension and other cardiovascular diseases in China.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RST is a potential candidate for the treatment of cardiovascular disease, and the active ingredients are still to be discovered and characterized.
the extract is a potent calcium‐channel antagonist with anti‐arrhythemic and anti‐infarct properties.
RST has a potential for the treatment of cardiovascular disorders.
